task_spec: Responses must be closed if any BaseException (including asyncio.CancelledError / cancellation) is raised while sending a request, not only ordinary Exceptions. Otherwise a cancelled request leaks its connection. (encode/httpx#2139 / #2156)

bugs.description: The send paths catch `except Exception` when closing the response on error, but asyncio.CancelledError (and KeyboardInterrupt) are BaseException, not Exception. So when a request is cancelled mid-send, the except block is skipped, response.close()/aclose() never runs, and the connection leaks. Correct is `except BaseException`. The same pattern repeats in _send_handling_auth and _send_handling_redirects for both the sync Client and AsyncClient (6 sites).
bugs.seed_note: NATURAL bug: inverse of the real fix in encode/httpx PR #2156 (closes #2139).
